item.text:
Search note: I used three search rounds across World Bank, IMF, UNICEF, UNHCR, ENA, HRW, Amnesty, Reuters/AP, then stopped.

**Bottom line**
Mixed, leaning no. Abiy’s 2024 record contains real welfare-oriented programs and rhetoric, but the year’s most consequential state behavior in Amhara and toward watchdogs undercuts the claim that human welfare was the core operating purpose.

**Positive**
- **[World Bank Backs Ethiopia's Reforms to Promote Sustainable and Inclusive Growth, Enhance Resilience, and Take Climate Action](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/07/30/world-bank-backs-ethiopia-s-reforms-to-promote-sustainable-and-inclusive-afe-growth)** | World Bank | 2024-07-30 | The operation explicitly aims to expand social safety nets, protect poor and vulnerable households, and support health/education/social protection portfolios. | `6B.1`, `5B.8`, `5B.10`
- **[Ethiopia signs 1.72 billion USD Financing Agreements with the World Bank](https://www.mofed.gov.et/blog/ethiopia-signs-172-billion-usd-financing-agreements-with-the-world-bank/)** | Ministry of Finance, Ethiopia | 2024-04-05 | Funds rural connectivity, food security, and adaptive safety nets as public-good investments aimed at inclusive growth rather than elite payoff. | `6B.1`, `5B.8`, `5B.10`
- **[Second Phase of PROSPECTS Launched in Ethiopia, Empowering Refugees, IDPs and Host Communities](https://www.unicef.org/ethiopia/press-releases/second-phase-prospects-launched-ethiopia-empowering-refugees-idps-and-host)** | UNICEF Ethiopia | 2024-03-21 | Government and partners launched an inclusion program centered on education, livelihoods, protection, and infrastructure for displaced and host communities. | `6B.1`, `5B.8`
- **[Social Welfare Key Pillar of Prime Ministerial Initiatives](https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_4920073)** | ENA English | 2024-08-05 | Prime ministerial office described housing for the elderly and economically vulnerable as a core ongoing initiative. | `6B.1`
- **[Ethiopia Considers Social Protection as Core Component of National Dev’t: Minister](https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_5452428)** | ENA English | 2024-11-13 | Social protection was described as remaining at the center of public policy and a bridge between citizens and government. | `6B.1`
- **[Building a Strong Foundation to Improve Learning Outcomes in Ethiopia](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/feature/2024/09/05/building-a-strong-foundation-to-improve-learning-outcomes-in-afe-ethiopia)** | World Bank | 2024-09-05 | The education program trained 102,117 teachers and reported improved learning outcomes, especially in disadvantaged regions. | `6B.1`, `5B.8`

**Negative**
- **[World Report 2024: Ethiopia](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/ethiopia)** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-01-12 | The report says aid diversion led WFP and USAID to halt food aid, sharply restricting access for about 20 million people. | `6B.1`, `5B.8`
- **[Ethiopia Military Executes Dozens of Civilians in Amhara Region](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/04/04/ethiopia-military-executes-dozens-amhara-region)** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-04-04 | Federal forces allegedly summarily killed dozens of civilians, showing civilian welfare was not protected as a governing priority in conflict zones. | `6B.1`, `5B.9`
- **[Ethiopia: Mass arbitrary detentions in Amhara region deepen erosion of rule of law](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/10/ethiopia-mass-arbitrary-detentions-in-amhara-region-deepen-erosion-of-rule-of-law/)** | Amnesty International | 2024-10-01 | Arbitrary mass detentions without warrants or timely court appearance point to coercive control, not welfare-centered rule. | `6B.1`, `5B.9`
- **[Ethiopia authorities suspend three rights groups](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/02/ethiopia-authorities-suspend-three-rights-groups)** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-12-02 | The government suspended watchdogs even while praising reforms, suggesting selective control outweighed open civic protection. | `6B.1`, `5B.9`

**Gap**
Direct first-person evidence from Abiy explicitly saying human welfare outranked regime security is limited. The strongest pro-welfare evidence is official program language and partner assessments; the strongest counterevidence is the 2024 conflict/repression record and the harm it inflicted on civilians, aid access, and watchdogs.
